# Network Address

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NetworkAddress`](gmeow-NetworkAddress.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NetworkAddress>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A network-layer address or locator expressed as a coordinate in a network reference frame — an IP address, MAC address, DNS name, URL, port number, or BGP autonomous-system number. The flat shortcut for the common case is [`gmeow:accessUrl`](../properties/gmeow-accessUrl.md) on a [`VirtualLocation`](gmeow-VirtualLocation.md); promote to [`NetworkAddress`](gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) when frame, provenance, confidence, or standpoint matters.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

Use [`gmeow:NetworkAddress`](gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to promote a virtual location's address to a frame-relative coordinate when the IP/MAC/DNS/URL/port/BGP-AS value needs an explicit frame, provenance, confidence, or standpoint.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the common case where a bare join URL suffices (use [`gmeow:accessUrl`](../properties/gmeow-accessUrl.md)) and avoid asserting CIDR/DNS containment as triples — that is a solver computation ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Type as [`NetworkAddress`](gmeow-NetworkAddress.md), set [`gmeow:networkAddressType`](../properties/gmeow-networkAddressType.md) and [`gmeow:networkAddressValue`](../properties/gmeow-networkAddressValue.md), and declare [`gmeow:networkAddressFrame`](../properties/gmeow-networkAddressFrame.md) nested under [`gmeow:referenceFrameInternet`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameInternet.md) via [`gmeow:parentFrame`](../properties/gmeow-parentFrame.md).

### Examples

- ex:siteAddr a [`gmeow:NetworkAddress`](gmeow-NetworkAddress.md); [`gmeow:networkAddressType`](../properties/gmeow-networkAddressType.md) [`gmeow:networkAddressTypeIPv4`](../individuals/gmeow-networkAddressTypeIPv4.md); [`gmeow:networkAddressValue`](../properties/gmeow-networkAddressValue.md) "192.0.2.1"; [`gmeow:networkAddressFrame`](../properties/gmeow-networkAddressFrame.md) [`gmeow:referenceFrameIPv4`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameIPv4.md).
